newsitem.title: USA: Mackie Designs sees weak Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Mackie Designs sees weak Q1 results.

text.p: Mackie Designs Inc said Wednesday results for its first fiscal quater, ended March 31, will be below expectations.

The company said in a statement the weaker results were due to lower than projected revenues coupled with accelerated expenditures caused by starting production of new products and realignment of manufacturing to meet growing demand for core products.
Analysts had forecasted Mackie would earn $0.14 for its first quarter compared with $0.17 in the year-ago quarter, according to First Call.
The company also said its Chief Financial Officer Thomas Elliott plans to resign on April 15 to concentrate on his own financial consulting business. He will remain as a consultant to Mackie.
Mackie said it has appointed Roy Wemyss as chief operating officer. No other infomation was immediately available.
